A cannula that's in place but not in use should generally be flushed with 0.9% sodium chloride at least every 8–12 hours (often every 12 hours, or every 8 hours under some local policies). In-use cannulas should also be flushed before and after each medication or infusion, using a pre-filled saline syringe of at least 5–10 mL with a pulsatile push-pause technique. Intervals and volumes vary with local hospital policy and with the line type (for example central lines or neonates), so check your own protocol.
